findings.claim: The doors are not independent lenses. STRENGTH, AQE_LEADER, ELDER+LENS, LENS and STRONG_SEAT all read the same five engines that sc_momentum already averages (flow, energy, structure, mp, elder). A name on four doors is one reading counted four times, and a decider who cites door count is citing breadth, not depth.
findings.evidence: ROIV doors SEATS, ELDER+LENS, STRENGTH, PM_LENS; MGNI STRENGTH, AQE_LEADER, PM_LENS, NOMINATED; LQDA ELDER+LENS, LENS, STRENGTH, STRONG_SEAT. sc_momentum is the weighted average of flow, energy, structure, mp, elder (card field meaning).

findings.claim: 14 names sit at their 52-week high and 10 of them did so on below-normal participation. Price at the high without volume behind it is a weaker read than the composite scores suggest. Deciders should read participation by condition, not in aggregate.
findings.evidence: pct_from_52w_high 0.0 on 14 names. day_vol below 1: ROIV 0.98, AMRX 0.57, EW 0.87, MGNI 0.91, ABBV 0.57, CAH 0.51, CNK 0.48, PRCH 0.51, TGTX 0.98, MSI 0.73. At or above 1: XERS 1.14, HUM 1.72, AXGN 2.42, ICE 1.17.

findings.claim: XERS is at its high after a very large lead over the market. The case must say how far price is from its own 50-day average and whether the thesis is continuation or the spike itself. The ma_50, ma_100 and ma_200 stack is rising, so context is present; the open question is how extended the entry is.

BTSG, CAH and ADP also carry BEARISH with div_bear_count 1; CNK is the strongest case. The case must say what price and volume would have to do to clear it.

findings.claim: DTE, BIPC and XEL all have the 50-day average below the 100-day below the 200-day. A momentum or pullback pattern inside a falling longer-term stack is a pattern in isolation until the case names the longer-timeframe trend it is meant to exploit. Three utilities also add to the same-sector overlap.

APP has the highest-ranked momentum read of the inverted-stack names, yet its averages are stacked downward and it sits far under its high. The momentum composite and the longer-timeframe context disagree. The case must name its higher-timeframe context or the name stands aside.
findings.evidence: sc_momentum 84.6; ma_50 298.73, ma_100 350.41, ma_200 407.34; pct_from_52w_high -44.82; rs_rank_pct 26.43; div_state BULLISH.
